Present 1.description: Inside the sewer outside the Disco. Grab a lantern when you enter to make it easier to see.

Present 2.description: Inside the sewer outside Grandma's house/The Jelly Man's house. Use the cleaning device to wash off the jelly to uncover it in the corner of the sewer.

Present 3.description: Inside the sewer out-front of the fire station. Collectable without putting out the fire because it does not hurt the player.

Present 5.description: On the second floor, in the room furthest down the corridor on the right.

Present 6.description: On the second floor, in the room next to the elevator, remove the Wonderful Wobbly Quiz poster from the wall to reveal a button. Pressing this button unlocks the top floor with the present.

Present 7.description: Upstairs in a cubicle behind the elevator.

Present 8.description: Inside the sewer in the tunnel. Melt the ice by fueling the boiler then find it in a room by going into the door directly to the left of the boiler.

Present 9.description: Behind the crates in the corner behind the locked door in the main sewer from the dock. (Must fix the broken pipes to get in)

Present 10.description: Behind some stacked crates in a corner in the main sewers before fixing all the pipes
